question: why is main green at 620 below-B definitions against a recorded baseline of 599?
measured: pmat 3.41.1 comply check --checks CB-200 --format json, cold XDG_CACHE_HOME, git archive of merge-base 00058476c323: '620 definition(s) below minimum grade B -- 21 OVER the recorded baseline of 599' (Fail); also 620 on main c68deb494
cause: nothing on main measures the count. scripts/check_cb200_tdg_grade.sh does not exist on origin/main (the car introduces it; guard_tree.sh picks up scripts/check_*.sh). check_complexity_ratchet.sh on main only ratchets the NUMBER in scripts/cb200_baseline.txt and checks it equals .pmat-gates.toml [tdg] baseline -- a shrink-only number that is never compared with the tree. The only pmat comply call in main's workflows is book.yml's, advisory (|| echo ::warning::) and unfiltered. So 21 below-B definitions merged one at a time with every required check green.
consequence: a gate that does not see main is theater: the recorded 599 described no tree after 237fbc32f (measured 602 there).
remedy: car #4429 wires check_cb200_tdg_grade.sh into guard_tree (every PR, cold index) and re-baselines once to 617 via receipt scripts/cb200_baseline.rebaseline (measured 620 at the merge-base); the 19 over 598 are cb200-main-below-b-0701.jsonl. Open for 0.70.1: run the guard on main pushes / nightly too, so main's own drift is measured, not only PRs'.
